summary: Both holes promoted to full exact records at high confidence, and the reorder turns out to END at ep 3: eps 4-5 are clean, monotonic Jack the Ripper (Red Butler Arc) blocks. Ep 4 = chs 6-8 (townhouse/Undertaker, Viscount Druitt's party, auction rescue + next-morning murder), ep 5 = chs 9-11 (stakeout/Grelle reveal, Madam Red unmasked, her cinematic-record backstory and death), dovetailing exactly with the existing ep 6 anchor (12-14). Fandom episode infoboxes and the fandom chapter-side reverse map (ch6/7/8 -> ep4, ch9/10/11 -> ep5, ch5 -> 'N/A') agree; wiki.gg agrees but its eps 4-5 pages are word-for-word fandom forks again, so the genuinely independent corroboration is Wikipedia's chapter list via exact Japanese title equality (ep 4 = Suikyo 酔狂 = ch 7's title; ep 5 = Kaiko 邂逅 = ch 9's title), ScreenRant's arc-level row (eps 4-6 = Red Butler Arc ending ch 14), and animefillerlist (both Manga Canon). Notable: ch 5 ('The Butler, Busy', the servants' day-in-the-life chapter) was never animated — fandom marks it N/A — so the ch-5 gap between ep 3's continue point and ep 4's start is a permanent skip, not a pending graft.

anchors.note: JTR arc opening block: ch 6 (London townhouse, tea with Madam Red/Lau/Grelle, Undertaker visit), ch 7 (Viscount Druitt's party, Ciel in disguise, magic-show diversion), ch 8 (auction, Sebastian's rescue, morning paper shows a new murder). No ch-5 content — that chapter was never animated (fandom: episodes = N/A). Monotonic; the eps 2-3 shuffle does not extend here.

Jack the Ripper reveal block: ch 9 (stakeout, Grelle unmasked as a reaper), ch 10 (Madam Red revealed as accomplice, fight begins), ch 11 (Madam Red's cinematic-record backstory, her death by Grelle's scythe). Fandom infobox 'Chapters 9-11'; fandom ch9/ch10/ch11 pages all reverse-map to Episode 5; ep 5's Japanese title Sono Shitsuji, Kaiko (邂逅) is exactly ch 9's title per Wikipedia's chapter list; dovetails with the verified ep 6 anchor (12-14: the Sebastian-Grelle fight, funeral, hunt). Volume 3 per both Wikipedia (v3 = chs 10-14) and stored boundaries.
